input.summary: Use the left flipper to repeat the upper-right gate and build bonus, use the right flipper to complete both Jacks, collect at the left saucer near 70,000, then use the lit spinner after 100,000.

quickInfo.name: Upper-right gate
quickInfo.summary: A left-flipper shot returns the ball to the upper playfield for more bonus advances.

quickInfo.name: Collect Bonus
quickInfo.summary: Complete both Jack standups to light the left saucer for a current-base-bonus collect.

quickInfo.name: Maximum bonus
quickInfo.summary: Reaching 100,000 base bonus lights the center spinner for 1,000 per spin.

quickInfo.name: Double Bonus
quickInfo.summary: Complete both Aces to light an alternating return lane, then roll through it to activate Double Bonus.

quickInfo.name: Lower gate
quickInfo.summary: Both Kings open a right-side gate that returns the ball to the plunger lane for another top feed.

steps.text: From the left flipper, shoot the upper-right gate. Use each return to build base bonus.
From the right flipper, shoot the two Jack standups. This lights Collect Bonus at the left saucer.
When base bonus reaches about 70,000, shoot the left saucer from the right flipper.
modeNotes: Collect Bonus: Both Jacks light the left saucer. The saucer awards the current base bonus and resets it.

steps.text: After the collect, return to the upper-right gate and rebuild bonus.
If base bonus reaches 100,000, use the left flipper to shoot the lit center spinner.
modeNotes: Maximum-bonus spinner: Reaching 100,000 base bonus lights the spinner for 1,000 per spin.

steps.text: When the spinner is weak, transfer the ball to the right flipper and collect bonus instead of forcing the spinner.

fallback.title: Upper-gate bonus build
fallback.when: Use this when the Jack targets, Collect Bonus saucer, or center spinner has a dangerous return.

steps.text: Repeat the upper-right gate from the left flipper.
Use top lanes and bumpers to build base bonus.
Complete both King targets to open the lower gate only when they are collected naturally.
Protect the built end-of-ball bonus instead of forcing a cashout.

alternatives.title: Double Bonus position play
alternatives.when: Use this only when base bonus is high and one safe Ace hit remains.

steps.text: Complete the second Ace to light the alternating return lane.
Guide the ball through the lit return lane to activate Double Bonus.
Do not collect base bonus at the saucer unless the match position requires immediate points.
Complete both Jacks to light Collect Bonus.
Shoot the upper-right gate to return the ball to the top, then score top lanes and bumper hits to raise base bonus.
Collect near 70,000 or later when the saucer feed is safe.
At 100,000, add the lit spinner or protect Double Bonus according to match position.

playfieldReferences.label: Upper-right gate
playfieldReferences.description: Gate used to build bonus through repeat upper play.
playfieldReferences.context: Repeat the upper-right gate from the left flipper.

techniques.name: Shatz transfer
techniques.instruction: Shoot the ball across the wide inlane gap from the left flipper to the right flipper. Use the right flipper for Collect Bonus.

techniques.name: Upper-right gate repeat
techniques.instruction: Use the left flipper to shoot the upper-right gate. Repeat only while its return remains controlled.

cautions.issue: Ace-target rebounds can reach an outlane or leave the ball uncontrolled.
cautions.response: Do not shoot an Ace until base bonus is high and the Double Bonus attempt justifies the risk.

cautions.issue: A center spinner shot can hit the bumper above it and return through the center.
cautions.response: Avoid a dead-center spinner hit. Use the upper gate or Collect Bonus when the bumper return is unsafe.

cautions.issue: The left saucer kickout and upper bumper exits can vary by machine.
cautions.response: Watch the first full return. Do not repeat a collect or gate shot until the feed is known.

input.simpleOverview: Super Straight uses the upper-right gate to build base bonus, two Jacks to light a left-saucer collect, and the center spinner after bonus reaches 100,000. Repeat the gate, complete both Jacks, collect near 70,000 or later, then use the lit spinner at maximum base.
input.overview: Super Straight uses the upper-right gate to build base bonus, two Jacks to light a left-saucer collect, and the center spinner after bonus reaches 100,000. Build through the upper-right route, complete both Jacks, and collect at the saucer when its feed is safe. At 100,000 switch to the 1,000-per-spin center spinner, adding Double Bonus only when the Ace and return-lane sequence is controlled.
